title: Anthropic to access about 3.5 GW of TPU compute through Broadcom

sources.quote: Separately, Broadcom, Google and Anthropic PBC (“Anthropic”) have expanded their current strategic collaboration under which Anthropic, beginning in 2027, will access through Broadcom approximately 3.5 gigawatts as part of the multiple gigawatts of next generation TPU-based AI compute capacity committed by Anthropic.

explain: Starting in 2027, Anthropic will get about 3.5 gigawatts of next-generation Google TPU computing through Broadcom. Broadcom gave no price and warned that how much Anthropic uses depends on Anthropic's continued commercial success.
